children: Overview
Hong Kong water utility's interim revenue fell 2.9% yr/yr amid reduced construction activity
Net income attributable to owners rose 16.4% yr/yr, driven by higher segment profits and cost controls
Company cut interim dividend to HK10 cents per share, down 23.1% from prior period
Outlook
Company expects industry to benefit from increased government funding and water tariff adjustments
China Water Affairs to prioritize capital expenditure controls and focus on policy-supported funding
Result Drivers
REDUCED CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITY - Co said revenue fell due to slowdown in construction and lower installation and maintenance work in city water supply and environmental protection segments
COST CONTROLS - Pipeline direct drinking water supply segment profit rose due to successful implementation of cost control measures
ONE-OFF GAIN FROM ASSOCIATE - Profit benefited from a one-off gain related to further acquisition of interest in Kangda International Environmental Company Limited

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the water & related utilities peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for China Water Affairs Group Ltd is HK$5.45, about 36.9% above its November 26 closing price of HK$3.98
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
